F_Coop.name: Cooperative Network
F_Coop.description: High-Era governance body responsible for corridor standards, records, and civic continuity.
F_Coop.politicalNotes: High-Era unity and continuity institution. Its surviving central standards contribute to later Core/Fleet political inheritance, but the Cooperative is not the mature post-Shattering Fleet.

F_BHA.name: Beacon Harmonization Authority
F_BHA.description: Authority overseeing harmonic stability, safety certification, and public assurance.
F_BHA.politicalNotes: High-Era safety and harmonic authority. Its certification culture and sigil language contribute to later Core/Fleet/Crown authority symbols; do not depict the BHA as a mature post-Shattering Fleet organization.

F_Convoy.name: Convoy and Trade Coalition
F_Convoy.description: Freight, medical, and trade operators dependent on corridor predictability.
F_Convoy.politicalNotes: Practical reliability, transparent routing, and person-to-person convoy coordination become part of the later Verge tradition; early convoy workers are not yet a mature Verge faction.

F_Outer.name: Outer Band
F_Outer.description: Peripheral worlds and engineering habitats practicing improvised maintenance.
F_Outer.politicalNotes: Underserved peripheral worlds develop local repair, salvage, and survival practices that become part of later Shard identity; early Outer workers are not yet the mature Shards.
